audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and cooldown text never gave Public Execution's real cooldown, so 'track it' had no number behind it.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and far longer than Purgatory's 120/100/80s. The window after she spends it is the only step-up worth taking.
audit.corrected: 130s stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], spikes[1], mid and the dos/donts.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Dash Chain'. Her Q was described as a double-hit. Repudiation was described only as a block. Locke's Q was called Ritual Nails.
audit.why: Ambessa's abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Q does not double-hit — striking an enemy transforms the next cast into Sundering Slam. Repudiation shields and braces, and deals INCREASED damage if it blocked non-minion damage, so dumping burst into the brace feeds it. Public Execution blinks to the farthest champion in a line, suppresses, then stuns. Locke's Q is Soul Nails.
audit.corrected: 'Dash Chain' replaced with Public Execution as the tracked cooldown across the full layer; Q described as the Cunning Sweep to Sundering Slam transform; the Repudiation brace punish stated; Soul Nails used.

audit.why: Repudiation carries a derived grounding flag that Riot's text does not support (shield, brace, slam only), so no grounding claim was written. Public Execution suppresses — whether QSS or Cleanse answers it is not in the file, so nothing was asserted either way.
